syntactic_simplification: Mice are very important in neuroscience research. They help scientists study the brain. Mice are a good model because scientists can control and study them easily. Researchers have often chosen male mice for experiments. They prefer male mice because female mice have a hormone cycle. This hormone cycle can change behavior. These changes might affect the results of the experiments.
lexical_simplification: Mice are very important in brain research. They help scientists learn about how the brain works. Mice are a good model because scientists can control and study them easily. Researchers have often picked male mice for tests. They like male mice because female mice have a hormone cycle. This hormone cycle can change how female mice act. These changes might affect the results of the tests.
paraphrase_or_explanation: Mice are very important in studying the brain. They help scientists learn about how the brain works. Mice are a good choice because scientists can easily control and observe them. Researchers often choose male mice for experiments instead of female mice. They prefer male mice because female mice go through a hormone cycle, which can change their behavior. This means that how female mice act might not be the same every time. These changes can make it harder to get clear results from the experiments.

source_text: Mice have long been a central part of neuroscience research, providing a flexible model that scientists can control and study to learn more about the intricate inner workings of the brain. Historically, researchers have favored male mice over female mice in experiments, in part due to concern that the hormone cycle in females causes behavioral variation that could throw off results.
target_text: Mice are very important in studying the brain. They help scientists learn how the brain works. Scientists can easily control and watch mice. Researchers often pick male mice for experiments instead of female mice. They choose male mice because female mice have a hormone cycle that can change how they act. This means female mice might not act the same every time, which can make it harder to get clear results from the experiments.
